carmen: quick idea: 'eviction-credit' admission controller to stop prefill storms that cause cross-tenant evictions.
mina: tl;dr?
carmen: tenants get a sliding-byte-credit bucket. prefill/admit must acquire bytes before writing into slab. credits replenish slowly or by reclaimed bytes.
sam: so it's rate-limiting measured in bytes not ops. neat.
todd: how do we charge for handoff/copy-on-write? double-charge risk.
carmen: policy: debit at admit; credit back only when reclaim observed. for same-tenant internal moves we can skip charging. cross-tenant moves pay both sides.
mina: edge cases: optimistic vs confirmed reclaim. admission can use optimistic returns to avoid blocking, but track confirmed for accounting.
nate: metrics: admission.requests, admission.grants_by_tenant, admission.wait_ms_p95, admission.reclaimed_bytes_by_tenant, admission.overdraft_incidents.
ops-bot: @infra-team request: equip kv-sim cluster to simulate credit exhaustion/cross-tenant eviction tests. Ticket: IRON-708.
carmen: rollout: 1) logs-only mode 2) small canary budgets 3) enforce in low-traffic cluster 4) tighten rules. feature-flagged.
sam: tests: unit bucket accounting, integration race for finite slab, chaos compaction while admits pending.
mina: integrate with AcquireHandle flow: check admission before prefill write; fast-path cache local allowance.
todd: failure modes: partition -> fail-open for latency-sensitive routes, fail-closed for imports. per-route defaults.
carmen: I'll draft RFC with API and dashboards. posting link once ready. thanks :thumbsup:
